method: Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) — Saaty 1–9 pairwise comparison scale
display_note: Weights derived via Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). Consistency Ratio: 0.03 ✓  (threshold < 0.10)

factors.label: Safety
factors.transform_note: score = (100 - dust_risk_score), so higher dust risk -> lower safety score

factors.label: Resources
factors.transform_note: Proxy: average of ice_score and sunlight_score (no standalone resource layer yet)

factors.label: Expansion
factors.transform_note: Proxy: neutral 50.0 for all sites (no terrain-flatness layer available yet)

factors.label: Scientific Value
factors.transform_note: Proxy: average of all three raw score layers (sunlight, ice, dust_risk)

rationale.safety_first: Crew survival is non-negotiable — ranked highest.
rationale.water_ice_second: On-site water is critical for life support and propellant (ISRU).
rationale.sunlight_resources_tied: Solar power generation and in-situ resources are equally important operational factors.
rationale.expansion_lower: Future-growth capacity matters but is secondary to immediate mission survival.
rationale.scientific_value_last: Site selection prioritizes mission viability over science return.
